Meta.Description: Projected linework for one ValeVision drawing, rendered from the model and stored so the web build never computes it. Coordinates are drawing millimetres, x right and y down, four numbers per segment: x0, y0, x1, y1. A plan reads world X and world Z; an elevation reads the run along the facade and minus the height. Ignore the block if Fingerprint does not match the drawing and model you hold.
Meta.CoordinateSpace: drawing millimetres, x right, y down
